fact: All 365 secondary schools in Lesotho report through DHIS2 for Education (LEMIS), with principals, teachers and IT staff in Leribe, Butha-Buthe and Berea districts trained 30 September to 4 October 2026 and only three of ten districts trained.
title: From Data Entry to Data Leadership: Lessons from Lesotho's DHIS2 for Education Training
